descriptionChirho: To await eagerly with intense expectation; a compound of ἀπό + ἐκ + δέχομαι emphasizing the straining forward in anticipation. Used exclusively for eschatological or salvation-hope contexts in the NT. In Rom 8:19 creation 'awaits' (ἀπεκδέχεται) the revelation of the sons of God; in 8:23 believers 'await' (ἀπεκδεχόμενοι) the redemption of their bodies; in 8:25 'we eagerly await' (ἀπεκδεχόμεθα) what we do not see. In 1 Cor 1:7 the Corinthians are 'awaiting' (ἀπεκδεχομένους) the revelation of our Lord. In Gal 5:5 we 'eagerly await' (ἀπεκδεχόμεθα) the hope of righteousness. In Phil 3:20 we 'eagerly await' (ἀπεκδεχόμεθα) a Savior from heaven. In Heb 9:28 Christ appears a second time to those 'eagerly awaiting' (ἀπεκδεχομένοις) him. In 1 Pet 3:20 God 'was waiting' (ἀπεξεδέχετο) patiently in the days of Noah. Glosses: arb مُنْتَظِرِينَ, heb מְצַפִּים/מְחַכִּים, hin प्रतीक्षा–करते, kor 기다리며, spa aguardando.
